theorems.name: Product-family test and hidden-cause mixing obstruction
assumptions: finite nonnegative joint mass table M
theorems.law: T*M_ij=row_i*column_j for all entries iff M factors (T>0); hidden-cause mixing or joint gains can destroy this property.
theorems.boundary: No arbitrary Bayesian compression or independence guarantee.

theorems.name: Conditional left-intertwining closure
assumptions: LW_t=Q_t L for every allowed phase
theorems.law: All finite mixed-time evolutions satisfy L product(W_t)=product(Q_t) L. With full-support L, all-start total-mass finiteness is equivalent; without it only represented starts are controlled.
theorems.boundary: Not the strong pointwise quotient WP=PQ; input restriction is essential.

theorems.name: Affine-action-mass conditional lift
assumptions: LW_f=Q_fL for every affine map f
micro-control and spatial position obey the declared conditional template
theorems.law: The full joint endpoint mass measure is reconstructible after each allowed boundary update; conditional degree-two moments follow through the existing ControlPacket interface.
theorems.boundary: No labeled-path or individual-weight histogram preservation.

theorems.name: Six-phase residue/environment 256-to-28 conditional model
assumptions: environment uniform within its occupied-count fiber conditional on position
actual environment redistribution at each packet end
theorems.law: Six phases admit 256-to-28 affine-mass lifts. Removing redistribution rejects the lift. Reduced mass is further lumpable to scalar3/4; a positive periodic potential proves total mass4 from admissible unit input.
theorems.boundary: Not a universal minimum, a free redistribution or a production memory benchmark.

theorems.name: Propagation of a failed-lift residual
theorems.law: LW^n-Q^nL=sum_j Q^j E W^(n-1-j); when row norms q,w<1, star discrepancy norm <= ||E||/((1-q)(1-w)).
theorems.boundary: Signed diagnostic residual is not a positive BRC weight or an exact quotient certificate.

theorems.name: Partial redistribution exact stability threshold
theorems.law: Equal/unequal two-class mass quotient is exact; all-depth mass finite iff theta>5/21. Uniform-start total on stable side is (16+48theta)/(21theta-5).
theorems.boundary: 5/21 belongs to this gain/retention model, not a universal heartbeat or physical constant.
